evidence.locator:
`id = −9504 + 12×kind + 3×value + tier`. Kind is checkbox0/radio1
> (`0x6740–0x676a`); value is ControlRecord+18 (`0x71ec–0x71f0`);
> tier is normal1/pressed2/disabled0 (`0x71f6–0x7208`, disabled wins).
> Value2 therefore requests mixed CICN checkbox −9497/−9496/−9498 and radio
> −9485/−9484/−9486 for normal/pressed/disabled. On a missing value2/3 CICN,
> `0x7264` changes only value to1 before retrying at the same kind/tier.
evidence.claim: Mixed selector arithmetic and value2→1 retry with unchanged kind/state tier.
evidence.limits: Caller kind/value/tier and availability are declared. No actual native provider/cache order, decoding/device, placement, text, precedence or compatibility-tail proof.

evidence.locator:
`0x731c–0x732c` starts tier 0, selects tier 1 for blob byte 9, then tier 2
for blob byte 8. `0x73b6–0x73ce` and `0x73da–0x73f2` index
`kind*24 + tier*8 + value*2`. For value 2/3, `0x73ae–0x73d8` probes the
selected `ics#` with GetResource; NULL changes only the value to 1. The final
draw helper also requires the selected mask (`0xf50c–0xf51e`). A missing color
resource is not that NULL result.
evidence.claim: Conditional signed table IDs and absent mixed-mask same-tier checked retry under declared native tier/value inputs.
evidence.limits: Source tier/value are assumptions, not established by public Boolean options. Same-fork mask existence stands for declared lookup outcomes, not native providers/cache or mask/color decoding, depth selection, transfer or whole-control fidelity.

evidence.locator: - State bytes (0x66e8–0x6770): blob byte8 is set when ControlRecord hilite is 254 or 255, so disabled and inactive are one state; byte9 is set for any other nonzero hilite; varCode&7 in {1,3} clears byte10 and byte11, and in {2,4} clears byte10 and sets byte11 (radio).
evidence.claim: Hilite 254/255 set blob byte8 (disabled and inactive are one state); other nonzero hilite sets byte9 (pressed); varCode&7 1/3 is checkbox, 2/4 radio (byte11).
evidence.limits: Byte derivation only. Which public or caller action produces each hilite/varCode is not established.

evidence.locator: - CICN lane (0x71ec–0x728a): value is ControlRecord+18; tier starts 1, byte9 makes it 2, byte8 makes it 0; for value 2 or 3 the id -9504+12*kind+3*value+tier is fetched through 0x10472 and a NULL result sets value to 1; the id is then recomputed and fetched again at the same kind and tier. There is no retry at another tier.
evidence.claim: CICN id -9504+12*kind+3*value+tier (tier 1 normal, 2 pressed, 0 disabled); value 2/3 NULL retries value 1 at the same kind and tier; no cross-tier retry.
evidence.limits: 0x10472 is taken as GetCIcon on the current resource file chain; its 18-slot cache does not cover -9504..-9481. Provider identity is not established.

evidence.locator: - Lane order (0x728c–0x7318): a non-NULL CICN is drawn and the routine exits at 0x7310; a NULL CICN branches to the icon lane at 0x7314, which re-reads value from ControlRecord+18, so the CICN value-1 retry does not carry over.
evidence.claim: A drawn CICN ends the routine; a NULL CICN enters the icon lane, which re-reads the control value.

evidence.locator:
`0x731c–0x732c` starts tier 0, selects tier 1 for blob byte 9, then tier 2
for blob byte 8. `0x73b6–0x73ce` and `0x73da–0x73f2` index
`kind*24 + tier*8 + value*2`. For value 2/3, `0x73ae–0x73d8` probes the
selected `ics#` with GetResource; NULL changes only the value to 1.
evidence.claim: Icon lane tiers 0 normal/1 pressed/2 disabled index the pinned 0x18b88 table; a NULL value-2/3 ics# retries value 1.
evidence.limits: Table and probe only. The 0xf4ba draw helper (depth choice, mask requirement 0xf50c–0xf51e) and the owning file are separate.

evidence.locator: - Value 3 (0x720a–0x7232, 0x7380–0x73a2): when value is 1 and the Gestalt('Acid') response byte +20 is nonzero, value becomes 3; the CICN lane also requires byte11 = 0 (checkbox), the icon lane does not. What sets that byte is not decoded.
evidence.claim: Value 1 becomes 3 when the Gestalt(Acid) response byte +20 is set (CICN lane checkbox only).
evidence.limits: What sets the Gestalt byte is not decoded.

evidence.locator: - Resource files (0x10472–0x106ac, 0x7364–0x736c): when Gestalt('Copl') returns noErr (0x104a8), 0x10472 calls UseResFile with the low word of its response, otherwise the current file stays; ids outside its 18-slot cache, or any id when the cache base a4@(3436) is NULL (0x104b0), reach _GetCIcon (0xaa1e), which searches from that file down the resource chain; the icon lane calls UseResFile(0), the System file, before GetResource('ics#'). Which open file owns a found resource is not established for either lane.
evidence.claim: The CICN lane fetches after UseResFile(Gestalt Copl low word); the icon lane fetches after UseResFile(0).
evidence.limits: Which open file owns a found resource is not established for either lane; the archive-fork-only chain is a declared assumption.

evidence.locator: - Placement (0x72a0–0x72d2, 0x732e–0x7360, 0x7060–0x70a4): the CICN lane computes h = left + 8 - trunc(width/2) and v = trunc((top + bottom - height)/2) from the control Rect and the CIcon bounds before calling 0xf68c and 0x102d0; the icon lane offsets the global a4@(430) rect by (left + 2, (top + bottom - 12) >> 1), widens it by 2 on each side, erases it (0xa8a3) and adds 4 to its bottom; the shared label routine 0x6d22 moves the pen to left + 18 when byte10 is 0. The helper destination semantics, the a4@(430) rect and the label baseline are not decoded.
evidence.claim: CICN h = left+8-trunc(w/2), v = trunc((top+bottom-h)/2); icon rect a4@(430) offset by (left+2, (top+bottom-12)>>1); label pen h = left+18 for checkables.
evidence.limits: Arithmetic only. 0xf68c/0x102d0 destination semantics, the a4@(430) rect and the label baseline are not decoded.

requirements.claim: Given explicit kind, value2 and normal/disabled tier and declared owned CICN availability, select the source-derived mixed ID or, on absence, value1 at the same kind/tier. Not historical provider/cache lookup or Boolean precedence.

Given explicit source kind/tier/value and a complete declared same-fork mask census, select the pinned icon ID, retrying value1 at the same tier only when the requested mixed mask is absent. No public-Boolean/native-state, provider/cache, depth or transfer proof.

For the sampled public rows (checkbox/radio x off/on/mixed x normal/disabled, empty label) draw the art the 2.3.1 lanes select over the archive's own fork: CICN -9504+12*kind+3*value+tier with the value-2 same-tier retry (0x71ec–0x728a), else the 0x18b88 icon entry with the missing-ics# retry (0x7314–0x73fa), under the declared public-to-native mapping and a clear Gestalt(Acid) byte +20.
Resolve checkable art from the resource files the original engine searches (CICN lane after UseResFile(Gestalt Copl), icon lane after UseResFile(0)), including art the archive omits.
Map public checked/mixed/disabled to the ControlRecord value and hilite that original callers set.
Draw a pressed checkable (blob byte9) with CICN tier 2 or icon tier 1.
Select value-3 art when the Gestalt(Acid) byte +20 is set (0x720a–0x7232, 0x7380–0x73a2).
Place the glyph in the control Rect as 0x72a0–0x72d2 (CICN) and 0x732e–0x7360 (icon) do.
Start the label at the 0x6d22 pen (h = left + 18 for checkables) and its baseline.
Copy the selected decoded raster into the empty-label output unchanged (alpha and opaque RGB).
Choose ics8, ics4 and the ics# mask for the device the way the 0xf4ba draw helper does.
